bounds: The working tree was ALREADY dirty when this round started (5 prior rounds, no git writes allowed): `git status` at session start listed src/index.ts among others. A19's external write is injected at the FILESYSTEM level (a FIFO served by a background writer) because rebind's read->compare->rename window is synchronous: an in-process writer cannot interleave. It reproduces the byte change the compare sees, not a second team-core process's read-modify-write.

The R2 policy is REPORT-then-proceed for an unproven handle (liveness="unproven"), with OWNERSHIP enforced by the record-trail rule; it is not a refusal on liveness. This is the documented choice the review allowed.
The A17 mutation witness mutates rebindSeats only (the verb under review), not the reseed bind; the reseed bind's TEAM write is already exercised by A1a/A2/A8.
